issue: Receipt source amount vs ledger amount: ₹16,282.45 residual across 4 receipts; the ₹5,340,795.62 in H.001 is a formula artifact of that view, not a residual
affected_rows: 4 receipts carry the residual after reversal netting (of the 11 traced in H.048); 3 live receipts have no ledger posting at all (H.033)
affected_amount: ₹16,282.45 residual (application-level ₹81,855,686.97 vs ledger-derived ₹81,839,404.52), made up of +₹16,627.45, -₹400.00, +₹53.00 and +₹2.00. The ₹5,340,795.62 reported by H.001 is not a residual: it is ₹5,357,078.07 of reversed forward postings that H.001's formula never subtracts, less the ₹16,282.45.
metrics_affected: M.COL.003 against M.COL.001 reconciliation; individual-receipt ledger tracing; the H.001/H.048 diagnostic's own reliability
evidence_files: H.001 (v_je_amount_reconciliation), H.048, H.033 (source_vs_ledger_diff_summary), T.journal_lines, T.coa_accounts, T.receipts
root_cause: H.001's je_net_amount is SUM(CASE WHEN is_reversal_of IS NULL THEN debit ELSE -debit END). Reversal lines carry credit and not debit, so the -debit branch always evaluates to zero and no reversal is ever subtracted: 112 reversal credits totalling ₹5,357,078.07 exactly offset the 112 forward debits they reverse, and ₹5,357,078.07 less ₹16,282.45 gives ₹5,340,795.62 exactly. The remaining ₹16,282.45 is 4 receipts: one of ₹16,627.45 with zero journal entries, and three posted at a different amount than the receipt records (-₹400.00, +₹53.00, +₹2.00); the four receipt ids are named in C.014 and in the DQ.006 section of data_quality_report.md. Aggregate P&L/revenue views (v_pnl, v_revenue_by_period) are unaffected: they use the reversal-excluded v_account_balances convention, which nets forward and reversal pairs correctly.
root_cause_confidence: PROVEN for the ₹5,340,795.62 artifact (H.001's formula recomputed directly from journal_lines; the decomposition is exact). NOT DETERMINABLE for why the 4 residual receipts differ: build_receipt_lines is not among the 28 exported function definitions and receipts carries no updated_at column, so a post-posting edit can be neither confirmed nor ruled out.

root_cause: Proven from exported evidence. v_tenant_aging's CTE is named ar_charges but carries no debit > 0 filter: it selects debit - credit over every account 1200 line with party_kind 'tenant', so payments, credit notes, reversals and deposit-settlement lines are all included as AR movement rather than only unpaid invoice charges. Each line is bucketed by its own journal_entries.entry_date, never by the settlement date of the invoice it relates to, so a payment ages from its own posting date. That is why buckets go negative: 0-30 is -₹57,463.94, 61-90 is -₹154,043.45 and 90+ is -₹4,198,767.03, while 31-60 is ₹4,488,604.27 against a portfolio net of ₹83,297.85 - these are gross movements, not outstanding balances. Separately, every bucket requires CURRENT_DATE - charge_date >= 0, so lines dated after the query date fall into no bucket while still counting in the view's total column: exactly three invoice-sourced debits qualify - ₹468.00 on 2026-08-31, ₹2,250.00 on 2026-09-06 and ₹2,250.00 on 2026-09-20 - and ₹78,329.85 + ₹4,968.00 = ₹83,297.85 exactly.
